name: Commerce Moyasar
description: Off-site Drupal Commerce payment gateway for Moyasar (moyasar.com), a Saudi Arabian PSP. Renders Moyasar's embedded payment form (credit card, Apple Pay, STC Pay) at checkout; on return the module re-fetches the payment server-side from Moyasar's API (HTTP Basic auth with the secret key) and completes the order on the API-reported status. The 2.0.x branch adds reusable saved payment methods (tokenized cards) and supports capture, void, and refund from the payment terminal.
project_description:
Commerce Moyasar module implements the Moyasar payment processing service ( Moyasar ) in Drupal Commerce.

 2.0.x branch support reusing payment method (saved credit cards) (tokenization) 

 Installtion instructions: 
 * You can install this module via Composer (recommended), or

* clone it from drupal.org Git repo, or

* Download the module from drupal.org

 Requirements: 
 In able to accept Mada cards, you have to apply the patch in this issue [#2775597]

 Configurations: 
 Get API and secret keys from Moyasar dashboard, then create and configure the new payment gateway as needed.

 This 2.0.x branch of this module is sponsored by Coders Enterprise Web & Mobile Solutions
